instruction: Use a Fusion 360 API script or command-line automation workflow for Fusion-compatible CAM generation. Read the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\impeller_test.step, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\tools.csv. Create a rotary or multi-axis toolpath for C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\impeller_test.step. The simplified impeller has six blades, uses the Z axis as the rotary axis, and should be posted with a rotary A, B, or C axis coordinate. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-38.nc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rotary_report.json. Tool definition: T1 is the rotary/multi-axis tool for the six-blade impeller toolpath. Write the output file(s) to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-38.nc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rotary_report.json.
